summary: Enhance your skills in promoting transparency and accountability in government institutions with our comprehensive training. Enroll today for impactful learning
lede: Transparency and accountability in government institutions involve making decisions, public spending, and results visible and answerable. This training is for public-sector managers, policy advisers, finance and procurement officials, and oversight staff who need to build and defend accountable processes. It covers documenting decision paths, linking budgets to performance, managing disclosures and data, setting measurable results, engaging citizens, designing controls, and responding to audits and other oversight.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals in and around government institutions who influence or manage how decisions, funds, and performance are handled.
audience: Senior and mid-level public sector managers
Staff from supreme audit institutions, inspectorates
Donor and development partner staff concerned
modules: Foundations of Transparency and Accountability in Government
Public Financial Management and Open Budgets
Information Disclosure, Data Management, and Open Government Tools
Citizen Engagement and Social Accountability Mechanisms
Internal Control, Audit, and Oversight Relationships
Leadership, Culture, and Change Management for Accountability
Designing and Implementing a Transparency and Accountability Action Plan
prerequisites: Participants are expected to have a foundational understanding of public sector operations and governance. Prior experience in working with or within government institutions is recommended.
